title: Earshot — your agent can hear now
pitch: An audio editor your AI agent can hear. Via 43 WebMCP tools it detects silences, reads the transcript, and proposes surgical edits on the timeline — you approve.
about_excerpt: An audio editor your AI agent can hear. Via 43 WebMCP tools it detects silences, reads the transcript, and proposes surgical edits on the timeline — you approve. Like Comment Story Updates Audio editing with webmcp Inspiration A while back I really wanted to be a YouTuber. The part that always killed it for me was editing — cutting out the ums, the long pauses, and the takes where I fumbled. It was slow and boring, and I'd give up. Now I know there are agentic tools for video editing but I did not find anything for just audio editing. What it does Earshot is a browser audio editor where your AI agent can actually hear the recording. It exposes its tools over WebMCP , so an agent can: Find silences, filler words, and long pauses Read a word-level transcript Cut audio just by removing words from the transcript Tighten pauses, level a quiet speaker, and add chapters Export the finished audio and captions The agent suggests the edits, and then I can approve How we built it Built with Codex and Claude doing most of the coding, plus a fair bit of manual product decisions from me on how it should look and feel. It runs entirely in the browser, with Whisper for transcription either through OpenAI or locally on your GPU. Challenges we ran into It was honestly pretty simple, codex and claude helped a lot. The only thing I had to work on was to make sure the transcription editing for accurate with whisper running on GPU Accomplishments that we're proud of The whole loop works end to end Editing audio by editing text actually feels natural Transcription can run fully on-device, no key needed What we learned The best part isn't automating everything — it's letting the agent do the boring work while I keep the final say WebMCP will make it fun to use boring products What's next for Earshot — your agent can hear now I will keep it opensource Built With canvas css html5 indexeddb javascript node.js onnx openai react tailwindcss transformers.js typescript vercel vite wavesurfer.js web-audio-api web-workers webgpu webmcp whisper zustand Try it out github.com earshot-beige.vercel.app Submitted to The WebMCP Challenge Created by Pradeep Kapoor Like Share this project: Updates Pradeep Kapoor started this project — Sep 03, 2026 11:21 AM EDT
